title: Chapter 194 Actively Attack The Red Camp
content:
Chapter 194 Actively Attack The Red Camp

Then, Wang Shuo led the Golden Fire Cavalry out of the camp.

There were several gullies on the Gobi Desert, tens of meters deep, connecting the two camps of the enemy and us.

Wang Shuo frowned. If the enemy concentrated all its forces to attack.

If they divided their troops to guard, they would definitely not be able to defend.

They could only defend the base camp.

And if they could calculate which channel the enemy would choose to attack and set up an ambush, then this battle could be said to be half won.

Wang Shuo continued to explore forward along a channel. Ayub and Gong Zheng walked in the front, keeping a certain distance from the rear army. If they encountered danger, with their strength, escaping should not be a problem. .

In the Red Camp.

At the head of the military tent, sat a centurion skeleton officer.

At this time, they were also deploying troops and arranging combat strategies.

Obviously, their efficiency was higher than that of Wang Shuo and others.

But they did not choose to take the initiative to attack.

The four skeleton captains, each leading 10 skeleton soldiers, began to deploy defenses around the camp.

Wang Shuo walked for about 20 minutes and came to the end of the passage.

He found the Red Army's base camp.

He saw that the other side had no intention of attacking immediately.

At this time, Guliji also came over.

"Lord, the enemy has five skeleton captains..."

Wang Shuo was delighted after listening to the report.

As the saying goes, speed is the essence of war!

He decided to take the initiative to attack.

He could not care about so much, so he could only take a gamble at this time.

While the other side has not left the camp yet, it is worth taking some risks to seize the entrance and gain geographical advantages.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered people to go back and bring his subordinates over. In this copy, communication means cannot be used.

Only 5 archers were left to guard the house.

After his subordinates came over, Wang Shuo directly asked the crossbow battalion to climb up the cliff and place catapults on the ridge of the gully.

The cavalry was hidden in another gully, waiting to come out as a surprise force.

The five archers and the Black Mountain Bandits brought some stones and built a simple fortification at the entrance of the passage to block the attack of the skeleton soldiers.

When everything was ready, Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

"Prepare to attack."

At Wang Shuo's command, the catapult's projectiles flew towards the Red Army camp.

This place is only two kilometers away from the Red Army camp and is within the attack range.

It was not until the camp was attacked by projectiles that the Skeleton Centurion decided to counterattack.

Everything was developing according to Wang Shuo's script.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but wonder, is it so simple?

In fact, this is mainly because these skeleton soldiers are not intelligent and can only fight on instinct.

If it were the elite of Black Dragon City thousands of years ago, they would have launched an attack on Wang Shuo's base camp as soon as possible.

The Red Army's main general, the Skeleton Centurion, is just a junior general, equivalent to a bronze boss. Gong Zheng alone can hold him back.

Although the number and level of the troops were equal, their intelligence levels were totally different.

So Wang Shuo fought quite smoothly in this battle.

The catapults did not cause too many casualties.

When the skeleton soldiers came to kill them.

Li Jianguo immediately switched to the bronze crossbow cart and started shooting the skeleton soldiers. Not long after, the archers could also shoot the skeleton soldiers.

Before the close combat, several skeleton soldiers fell to the ground.

When the skeleton soldiers entered the designated battlefield, Ayub also rushed out with the cavalry.

Of these skeleton soldiers, half were infantry, and a few were archers and skeleton knights.
